cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Remember Me Correctly
cards.instruction: Create small tests of whether someone remembers your preferences, stories, or shared history.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before you take the tea through, which cup is mine?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you just take one? Everyone's waiting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Twelve years of breakfast together. Which one have I always used?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The blue one. Your name's underneath.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Correct, but turn it upright. How much milk? I haven't written that on the handle.
